note: Editorial curation, not derived data, and no longer the live source. The Effect Index featured carousel is now stored in Postgres (siteConfig, key "effect-index-featured-replications") and edited in /dev -> Replications -> Featured; this list is the fallback the homepage reads when a deployment has never been curated, and the record of what the carousel shipped with. Each slug is resolved against the existing replication read and any slug that no longer resolves is skipped silently. Slugs were repointed to their current names on 2026-08-11 after the artist-identity rename; effectIndexFeaturedReplications.test.ts fails the build if any entry goes stale again.
provenance: Recovered from the legacy effectindex.com dump, which flagged 69 replications as featured. 36 of those map confidently onto current rows and are listed below. 30 were left out as ambiguous — duplicate rows and filename-derived slugs made it impossible to say which current row the legacy flag belonged to — and 3 are unrecoverable, with no current row at all. The omission is a decision, not an oversight: 36 is far more than a one-at-a-time carousel needs, and shipping a wrong mapping would credit the wrong artist.
